projects.title: GenAI Internal Support Automation
projects.shortDescription: Introduced a GenAI-powered documentation and support system that reduced engineering support load by 40% and improved team productivity by ~20%.
projects.situation: As the Zeos partner platform scaled, engineering faced a critical bottleneck where support load grew linearly with adoption, creating a 'hidden tax' on productivity. Analysis revealed that ~40% of tickets were preventable if better documentation and easy access existed.

research: Analyzed support data: “Which API / where is X documented?”, “What’s the schema/table / config?”, “How to use the tool?”
Found ~40% of tickets were preventable through better documentation and self-serve access
Validated problem using genesis public chat analysis and support data from Aug-Sep 2025
strategy: Framed the solution as a 3-layer intelligence system: Single source of truth, Automated knowledge generation, and Conversational access
Aligned directly with platform tenets and justified investment via a Product Strategy & Execution Brief
Decided on VS Code with Copilot + Prompts for the MVP
development: Layer 1: Automated Documentation (Foundation) — Created a 'Zero-to-Doc' pipeline using GenAI prompts to ingest PRDs and System Designs
Layer 2: L0 Support Agent (The Interface) — Built an 'Always-on' Support Agent embedded in Google Chat with a RAG pipeline powered by Claude
Next Step: Layer 3 Agentic Operations — Integrating MCP with Jira and Zeos APIs to enable the agent to act (Get-Read-Write) and fetch real-time data directly in the chat

impact: Reduced engineering time spent writing docs to ~10 minutes per feature
The bot handled 20% of support requests autonomously
lessons: GenAI success depends more on context design than model choice
High-leverage GenAI requires product discipline, not hacks
You need teams comfortable with experimentation and iteration

projects.title: German with Nik: Voice-First German Learning AI App
projects.shortDescription: Built and shipped a voice-based GenAI product to help immigrants practice spoken German, taking it from problem discovery to production, with hundreds of users and continuous optimizations.
projects.situation: Language learning tools failed for conversational fluency because of: No real-time feedback, No safe space to practice speaking, Fixed schedules with teachers, and High cognitive load switching between text and speech.

research: Validated problem via Reddit threads, Immigrant communities, and Personal network
Found a clear pattern: people wanted low-pressure speaking practice on demand
Conducted market analysis showing coaching costs of €100–€200+ per month
strategy: Defined a clear wedge: Voice-first, conversational practice with immediate feedback
Established constraints: Low latency, Low cost, Grounded grammar (avoid hallucinations), Natural UX
development: Iteration 1: Built a full flow without AI to validate UX, then integrated ChatGPT for responses
Iteration 2: Introduced system persona (“Nik”), added conversational memory, and tuned prompts for corrective feedback
Iteration 3: Tested multiple models to reduce cost while maintaining quality
Iteration 4: Moved to backend workflow: Voice → Text → LLM → Speech to reduce latency and cost significantly
Iteration 5: Introduced RAG to ground grammar rules, added analytics, and performed manual evals to assess response quality

impact: Strong qualitative feedback on confidence and ease of practice
Deep hands-on learning across UX for GenAI, Context design, Model trade-offs, Cost vs quality decisions, and Evaluation challenges
lessons: Context and memory matter more than raw intelligence
Evaluation is the hardest unsolved problem
Production GenAI is systems engineering + product judgment

projects.title: Enterprise Banking Platform Transformation
projects.shortDescription: Strategic team alignment for financial technology scale, leading to accelerated delivery timelines and improved collaboration.
projects.situation: Platform and Solutions Teams were misaligned with different goals, creating delivery bottlenecks.

research: Conducted stakeholder interviews across teams to identify core friction points
Analyzed development workflows and team structures
strategy: Developed dual-track approach to platform and product development
Designed new team structure and collaboration framework
development: Implemented agile ceremonies to align roadmaps
Created shared KPIs between platform and product teams

impact: Improved platform quality with 40% fewer critical bugs
Enhanced team morale and reduced attrition by 30%
Strengthened customer relationships with more predictable releases
lessons: Organizational design is as critical as technical architecture
Executive sponsorship is essential for structural changes
Sharing context between teams is more valuable than rigid processes

projects.title: Self-Serve Identity Platform
projects.shortDescription: Built a self-service identity platform that reduced support tickets by 30% and transformed access management across internal and external users.
projects.situation: Identity changes and access requests relied on tenant admins and manual workflows, creating friction and ticket overhead.

research: Traced user journeys to identify pain points
Interviewed customers and admins about access management
strategy: Designed self-service portal for all identity management
Created approval workflows to maintain security
development: Implemented audit trails and compliance reporting

impact: Eliminated 2-5 day wait times for access changes
Created industry-standard experience comparable to Okta and Ping
lessons: Self-service requires clear guardrails and policies
Identity management is a key enabler of business agility
UX investment has exponential returns in identity products
